sketch:
Observe: canvas with a small palette of gates (ET, OU, NON, NAND,
NOR, XOR) and input toggle switches (0/1) driving LEDs at the
output. Student drops one gate, flips inputs, and a truth table
auto-fills row by row. Experiment: combine 2–3 gates to build a
target function (e.g., a half-adder: sum via XOR, carry via AND) —
LEDs verify against the target truth table. Evaluate: gate labels
hidden inside a boxed network; student flips inputs, observes
outputs, and identifies the function. Wrinkle: NAND-only
completeness — rebuild XOR using only NANDs.
